method: imagegen-designed cutout components; original articulated skeletal keyposes; fixed-size bone parts, no full-frame stretch
notes: Source component dimensions normalized once; each animation rotates and translates individual components.
No 3D models, source game artwork, or external assets used.
Traversal poses are in place; a game engine must move the root and align hands with level geometry.
RGBA PNG is authoritative; GIF previews composite transparency onto an opaque checkerboard and quantize colours.
Artwork has small soft edge coverage from antialiasing, not baked motion blur.
